relation.continuous: 8-step RGB-D pairs on the 1.0s immediately after opening and at final 1.0s hold, snapshots of full load phase; multiple empty/support-side/rim samples plus current printed plane; explicit closed/partially opened fingers, payload raised and tilted on placement, phantom support red/different ID and physical occlusion.
relation.negative: real mismounted/translated elevated cube, static held low with bilateral closed, missing floor/rim/region, stale data, slip and tilt. No assumed support by stage or unobserved time. Triple fit starts and separate unseen entire trajectories.

scope: new camera noise and physical paired controls, pre-committed projection and source classifiers before validation. No formal episodes or evaluation slots.

surface.chosen_camera_pixel: original 171,122 plus differing silhouette hand/self-shadow/side rays selected by physical registration in independent views and central paint pixels. Diagnostic fixture inserts pin after baseline archived pixel selection, never uses pixel for fit of bound target pose.
negative_reads: mismatched scene, stale step, missing depth, unsupported 3D, true changed unobscured pixel
surface.pin: original one-pixel pin plus (same optical ray) thin opaque tip at distances 20,40,80mm ahead of the native return; plus red and dark pin and larger foreground body; any physically distinguishable closer obstacle stops, if red-lookalike indistinguishable then no certificate for that silhouette class.
